memberdef.argsstring: (const u32 SubsystemId, const u32 DeviceId, XPm_DeviceStatus *const DeviceStatus)
memberdef.name: XPmPower_GetStatus

inbodydescription.para: Check if any power domain is ON and its parent is requested power domain, then explicitly power down those such power domains.

This is a special use case where child power domain is ON but no device of that power domain is requested. So use count of child power domain is 0. Also parent power domain usecount does not consider this child power domain as no device is requested.
So to force power domain in this case, increment child and parent both power domain and call power down of child power domain which powers off child power domain without affecting usecount.
